neighbours.label: A modifier that names a scheme or regime, at the point where the next word says what kind of thing it is: 'observer [pattern]', 'interval [training]', 'zonal [marking]', 'subscription [model]' (the + pole is the same slot before 'box': black box, set-top box)
fire: The class is built with the singleton pattern so only one copy exists.
His trainer swears by interval running on the track.
The defence uses zonal coverage instead of following each player.
Events are delivered through the observer mechanism in the toolkit.
The newspaper moved to a subscription model after ad revenue fell.
She follows a progressive overload plan in the gym.
The office traffic goes through a proxy gateway for filtering.
Many dieters try intermittent fasting during the week.
quiet: The class is built with great care so only one copy exists.
His trainer swears by early mornings on the track.
The defence was tired after following each player all game.
Events are listed on the poster in the hallway.
The newspaper moved to a new building after the fire.
She keeps a black box of old photos in the gym locker.
The office traffic was heavy on Friday afternoon.
Many dieters eat salad during the week.

notes: The - pole's output promotes ' pattern', ' model', ' patterns'. Probes: observer pattern 0.75, zonal 0.58, interval training 0.56, subscription business model 0.39, proxy server 0.31, intermittent fasting 0.20; 'a long rest' 0.13, 'black box' 0.03.
